classification.difficultyReason: Match the marked perpendicular height to its corresponding side despite the rotated figures, then multiply to find parallelogram area.

content.prompt: Find the areas of these regions.

spec.description: Rotated parallelogram with an 8 cm upper base, a red dashed perpendicular height dimensioned 13 cm, an upper right-angle mark and matching single and double parallel marks. The dashed height meets the opposite base close to its left endpoint.
spec.mathematics: The 13 cm dimension is perpendicular to the 8 cm base.

spec.description: Parallelogram with right side labelled 14 m and a red dashed 12 m perpendicular from the left side to the bottom-right vertex. A right-angle mark joins the perpendicular and right side. Opposite sides have matching single and double parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: The 12 m perpendicular height corresponds to the 14 m side used as base.

answer.worked:
Use the $14\ \mathrm{m}$ side as the base; its perpendicular height is $12\ \mathrm{m}$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Area}&=\text{base}\times\text{height}\\\text{Area}&=14\times12\\\text{Area}&=168\ \mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$
